description: Year 4 theological working drafts; require individual editorial review. Not published.

comparisonReferences: Deeper Life Bible Church doctrinal teachings and Daily Manna
Mountain of Fire and Miracles Ministries prayer teaching

entries.title: Strength for Today — Daily Discipleship
entries.reflection: A clear gospel witness speaks of Christ's cross, resurrection, and repentance. Consider a moment of gratitude in the light of this teaching. Seek counsel grounded in the Scriptures.
entries.prayer: Father, make me a compassionate soul-winner as I face a moment of gratitude; teach me to obey Your Word. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Churches seeking spiritual awakening must honour God's Word and care for souls. Consider a temptation to complain in the light of this teaching. Pray, then take the next responsible step.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my devotion to Your Word as I face a temptation to complain; teach me to walk in love. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Heavenly Key emphasises purity before spiritual power; character matters. Consider a period of spiritual dryness in the light of this teaching. Serve quietly without seeking attention.
topics.prayer: Father, purify my motives and actions as I face a period of spiritual dryness; teach me to obey Your Word. Amen.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: The resurrection of Jesus gives believers hope beyond present trials. Consider a need to listen in the light of this teaching. Confess a fault rather than hiding it.
topics.prayer: Father, anchor my hope in Christ as I face a need to listen; teach me to pray in faith. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Private prayer should accompany public service rather than being neglected. Consider a promise you made in the light of this teaching. Examine the motives behind your decision.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to intercede faithfully as I face a promise you made; teach me to honour Jesus. Amen.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Justification is grounded in Christ's atonement, not human achievement. Consider a disagreement at church in the light of this teaching. Keep a promise despite inconvenience.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance as I face a disagreement at church; teach me to act honestly. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Believers should seek wisdom before making major decisions. Consider a misunderstanding in the light of this teaching. Bring the promise of Scripture to mind.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my obedient faith as I face a misunderstanding; teach me to serve humbly. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Holy Spirit empowers believers to bear witness to Jesus Christ. Consider an unfair accusation in the light of this teaching. Speak about Christ with compassion.
topics.prayer: Father, empower me for holy witness as I face an unfair accusation; teach me to walk in love. Amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: A clear gospel witness speaks of Christ's cross, resurrection, and repentance. Consider a moment of gratitude in the light of this teaching. Seek counsel grounded in the Scriptures.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a compassionate soul-winner as I face a moment of gratitude; teach me to obey Your Word. Amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Christian unity is strengthened by patience and doctrinal faithfulness. Consider anxiety about the future in the light of this teaching. Make amends for wrong conduct where appropriate.
topics.prayer: Father, help me love in truth as I face anxiety about the future; teach me to pray in faith. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: A persuasive slogan must never replace careful Bible study. Consider an apology you owe in the light of this teaching. Express mercy through practical care.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Scripture as I face an apology you owe; teach me to honour Jesus. Amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Discernment requires prayer, humility, and attention to Scripture. Consider a difficult family conversation in the light of this teaching. Read the passage in its biblical context.
topics.prayer: Father, give me discernment and wisdom as I face a difficult family conversation; teach me to act honestly. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Heavenly Key teaches the rapture and resurrection of the saints. Consider a chance to speak truth in the light of this teaching. Trust God's wisdom while doing your duty.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me ready for Christ's return as I face a chance to speak truth; teach me to serve humbly. Amen.

entries.title: Strength for Today — Daily Discipleship
entries.reflection: Believers show love through practical service and gentle correction. Consider someone who needs encouragement in the light of this teaching. Bring the promise of Scripture to mind.
entries.prayer: Father, help me love in truth as I face someone who needs encouragement; teach me to pray in faith. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Revival must produce humility, holiness, and compassion instead of boasting. Consider a need to examine motives in the light of this teaching. Receive correction without pride.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my devotion to Your Word as I face a need to examine motives; teach me to walk in love. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: The Lord calls believers to holiness in thoughts, speech, and actions. Consider a temptation to show off in the light of this teaching. Pray for those with whom you disagree.
topics.prayer: Father, purify my motives and actions as I face a temptation to show off; teach me to obey Your Word. Amen.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: God is a refuge even when a difficult season does not immediately end. Consider an uncertain choice in the light of this teaching. Let holiness and love shape your action.
topics.prayer: Father, anchor my hope in Christ as I face an uncertain choice; teach me to pray in faith. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Prayer for others can lead to appropriate acts of mercy. Consider a season of waiting in the light of this teaching. Pray, then take the next responsible step.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to intercede faithfully as I face a season of waiting; teach me to honour Jesus. Amen.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Where possible and right, restitution reflects a repentant conscience. Consider a request for help in the light of this teaching. Serve quietly without seeking attention.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance as I face a request for help; teach me to act honestly. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Faith in Christ leads believers toward obedience, not empty claims. Consider someone who has offended you in the light of this teaching. Confess a fault rather than hiding it.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my obedient faith as I face someone who has offended you; teach me to serve humbly. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Heavenly Key teaches Holy Ghost baptism and the Spirit's gifts for believers. Consider an opportunity to show mercy in the light of this teaching. Examine the motives behind your decision.
topics.prayer: Father, empower me for holy witness as I face an opportunity to show mercy; teach me to walk in love. Amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The mission to reach nations must remain truthful and humble. Consider a responsibility at home in the light of this teaching. Keep a promise despite inconvenience.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a compassionate soul-winner as I face a responsibility at home; teach me to obey Your Word. Amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Believers show love through practical service and gentle correction. Consider someone who needs encouragement in the light of this teaching. Bring the promise of Scripture to mind.
topics.prayer: Father, help me love in truth as I face someone who needs encouragement; teach me to pray in faith. Amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: The Bible is the inspired and final authority for faith and conduct. Consider a neighbour in need in the light of this teaching. Speak about Christ with compassion.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Scripture as I face a neighbour in need; teach me to honour Jesus. Amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Wise Christians test claims instead of accepting every strong feeling. Consider a time of prayer in the light of this teaching. Seek counsel grounded in the Scriptures.
topics.prayer: Father, give me discernment and wisdom as I face a time of prayer; teach me to act honestly. Amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Readiness for eternity must not become speculative date-setting. Consider a temptation to complain in the light of this teaching. Make amends for wrong conduct where appropriate.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me ready for Christ's return as I face a temptation to complain; teach me to serve humbly. Amen.
